disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is purely an artifact of a tool error (HTTP 400) in the first model when reviewing .SRCINFO, causing it to return an overall 'inconclusive' verdict. coverage_issues: First model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should not fail the entire package audit or mark it inconclusive if a non-executable metadata file like .SRCINFO fails to process due to an API error. The final verdict should be derived from the executable packaging files (PKGBUILD, .install).
Implement graceful degradation for transient API errors on low-risk, non-executable files so they do not block a conclusive safe verdict.
